chunks: A number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ibn Fazzal, from Thal'abah ibn Maymun, from Huzayl, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
When you buy a slave girl, say: 'O Allah, I consult You and seek Your choice of goodness.'

key_terms.أَسْتَخِيرُكَ: I seek Your choice of goodness (Istikhara)

ai.seo_question: What supplication should be recited when buying a slave girl according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi highlights the practical application of istikhara (seeking divine guidance) in commercial transactions, specifically for acquiring a slave girl, reflecting the Shia emphasis on integrating spiritual awareness into daily economic activities. It underscores the concept of seeking Allah's counsel (istishara) alongside His choice of goodness, ensuring that the acquisition aligns with divine wisdom rather than mere personal desire. This practice is rooted in the Prophetic tradition of consulting God in matters of uncertainty, reinforcing the believer's reliance on divine decree in worldly affairs.
